),

    SELECT DISTINCT bo.orderid,
           CASE WHEN sd.specialdealid IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS has_promotion
    FROM bf_orders bo
    JOIN sales.customers c ON bo.customerid = c.customerid
    JOIN sales.orderlines ol ON bo.orderid = ol.orderid
    JOIN warehouse.stockitemstockgroups sig ON ol.stockitemid = sig.stockitemid
    LEFT JOIN sales.specialdeals sd
        ON (sd.buyinggroupid = c.buyinggroupid OR sd.buyinggroupid IS NULL)
        AND (sd.customerid = c.customerid OR sd.customerid IS NULL)

    SELECT generate_series(2000, 2020) AS order_year
),
backorder_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orderdate)::int AS order_year,
